items.title: Travelers and National Trust for Historic Preservation Bring National Resilience Campaign to Minnesota
items.summary: “Travelers Across America” initiative brings partners together to focus on community resilience at the historic Oliver Kelley Farm The Travelers Companies, Inc. (NYSE: TRV ) and the National Trust for Historic Preservation today celebrated the fourth event of their national preservation and community resilience campaign, Travelers Across America , in Elk River, Minnesota. The initiative, which focuses on restoring landmarks and strengthening community resilience in honor of America’s 250th, hosted a volunteer day at Oliver Kelley Farm featuring hands-on stewardship projects led by Travelers employees. The event was supported by the Minnesota Historical Society and the National Trust’s Hands-on Preservation Experience (HOPE) Crew , which equips young people with the vital skills needed to protect historic sites across the country. items.title: Travelers Expands Product Liability Insurance to California Life Sciences Companies
items.summary: The Travelers Companies, Inc. (NYSE: TRV ) today announced that Travelers Synergy ® – its product liability insurance offering for life sciences companies – is now available in California, completing its rollout across all 50 states. What Travelers Synergy Covers Travelers Synergy is designed to protect life sciences companies against product-related claims at any point in the product development life cycle – from research and development through manufacturing and distribution. Core coverage addresses bodily injury and property damage, and can be supplemented with optional add-ons, including: Errors and omissions liability. Product recall expenses. Clinical trial medical expenses. What’s New for Travelers Synergy Policyholders Travelers has introduced broader Sales Professional Liability coverage for life sciences companies whose sales representatives work in operating rooms, procedure rooms or other clinical settings.
